$comment: Base compiler options required by reference/typescript.md.
MERGE these into the framework's generated tsconfig - do not replace it.
Frameworks set jsx, lib, moduleResolution, module, and types deliberately;
overwriting them breaks the build in ways that are annoying to diagnose.
For a LEGACY project do not enable all of these at once. Ratchet one flag at
a time in the order given in reference/legacy-adoption.md - strictNullChecks
and noUncheckedIndexedAccess are real work, not config changes.
Set `paths` to match the bundler alias. An alias configured in tsconfig but
not in the bundler typechecks fine and fails at runtime.
